cmsy_input(): 将FAO渔获数据转换为CMSY++输入文件

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/cmsy_input.Rmd
cmsy_input.Rmd

英文原页：cmsy_input()

说明

本函数将FAO渔获数据转换为CMSY++（Froese等，2021，2023）的两个输入文件：渔获量文件（Stock、yr、ct、bt）和ID文件（每个种群一行，包含先验和设置）。每个种群的恢复力和种群内禀增长率r的先验取自本包内置的FishBase和SeaLifeBase数据表（见cmsy_priors()），并注明每个值的来源。

English

This function turns FAO catch data into the two input files of CMSY++ (Froese et al. 2021, 2023): the catch file (Stock, yr, ct, bt) and the ID file, one row per stock, with the priors and settings. Each stock gets its resilience and r prior from the built-in FishBase and SeaLifeBase table (see cmsy_priors()), with the source of each value.

用法 

cmsy_input(
  area_data,
  species = NULL,
  by = c("area", "country"),
  priors = NULL,
  default_resilience = NULL,
  min_years = 10,
  min_catch = 1000,
  max_filled = 0.2,
  table = TRUE,
  lang = NULL,
  label = NULL,
  silent = fao_setting("silent")
)

参数

area_data
FAO渔获数据：fishing_area_data()$area_data，或load_fao_data()的任意子集（例如一个国家，或几个渔区）。
English FAO catch data: fishing_area_data()$area_data, or any subset of load_fao_data() (e.g. one country, or several fishing areas).
species
要保留的物种（可选），可以用FAO英文或中文名称、中英文名称合写（与lang = "both"时显示的形式相同）、学名或FAO三字母代码，例如c("Atlantic herring", "Mallotus villosus", "PRA")，也可以用中文名称。默认为NULL，即所有物种。
English Optional species to keep, by English or Chinese FAO name, both together (as shown with lang = "both"), scientific name or FAO 3-alpha code, e.g. c("Atlantic herring", "Mallotus villosus", "PRA") or Chinese names. Default is NULL, all species.
by
“area”（默认）：每个物种条目和渔区为一个种群，按国家合计；“country”：每个物种条目、渔区和国家为一个种群。
English “area” (default): one stock per species item and fishing area, summed over countries; or “country”: one stock per species item, fishing area and country.
priors
可选的数据框，给出用于替代默认值的先验和设置，每个种群或物种一行。用Stock、alpha3、species_en或species列识别各行（species：任何名称，与species参数相同），并可包含ID文件的以下任意列：Resilience、r.low、r.hi、stb.low、stb.hi、int.yr、intb.low、intb.hi、endb.low、endb.hi、StartYear、EndYear和Comment。在这里给出的值，其来源记为”user”（用户）。只给出Resilience而没有给出r.low和r.hi时，FishBase或SeaLifeBase中的r范围由该恢复力对应的范围替代（只要同时给出r.low和r.hi，CMSY++就使用这两个值）。每一行适用于其最具体的标识所对应的种群：有Stock时只适用于该种群，即使该行也给出了物种；否则适用于该物种的所有种群。物种的行先于单个种群的行应用，因此为某个种群给出的值优先。
English Optional data frame of priors and settings that replace the defaults, one row per stock or species. It identifies the rows by a Stock, alpha3, species_en or species column (species: any name, as in the species argument) and can have any of the ID file columns Resilience, r.low, r.hi, stb.low, stb.hi, int.yr, intb.low, intb.hi, endb.low, endb.hi, StartYear, EndYear and Comment. Values given here are recorded as “user”. A Resilience given without r.low and r.hi replaces the r range from FishBase or SeaLifeBase with the range of that resilience (CMSY++ uses r.low and r.hi whenever both are given). A row applies to the stocks of its most specific identifier: only its stock when it has a Stock, even if it also names the species; else all stocks of its species. Rows for a species are applied before rows for one stock, so the values given for a stock take precedence.
default_resilience
物种在FishBase或SeaLifeBase中没有恢复力或r先验时，其种群所用的恢复力（“High”、“Medium”、“Low”或”Very low”）。默认为NULL：由于用户指南没有给出默认值，这类种群不予纳入。
English Resilience (“High”, “Medium”, “Low” or “Very low”) for stocks whose species has no resilience or prior r in FishBase or SeaLifeBase. Default is NULL: such stocks are left out, since the user guide gives no default.
min_years
从有渔获量的第一年到最后一年的最少年数。默认为10。
English Minimum number of years from the first to the last year with catch. Default is 10.
min_catch
一个种群的最小总渔获量，单位为吨。默认为1000。
English Minimum total catch of a stock, in tonnes. Default is 1000.
max_filled
一个种群中可用插值填补的年份所占的最大比例。默认为0.2。
English Maximum share of the years of a stock that may be filled by interpolation. Default is 0.2.
table
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，表格保存在tables/。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), tables are saved in tables/.
lang
图表文字和名称的语言：“en”（英文）、“zh”（中文）或”both”（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用fao_settings()设置的语言（未更改时为”en”）。
English The language of the chart text and names: “en” (English), “zh” (Chinese) or “both” (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with fao_settings() (“en” unless changed).
label
输出文件名中使用的名称。默认为数据所属的渔区（或国家）。
English The name used in the output file names. Default is the fishing area (or the country) of the data.
silent
逻辑值。为TRUE时不输出任何提示信息。默认为FALSE，或使用fao_settings(silent = )设置的值。
English A logical value. If TRUE, no messages are printed. Default is FALSE, or the value set with fao_settings(silent = ).

返回值

以不可见方式返回一个cmsy_input类的列表，包含catch和id（CMSY++的两个输入表）、stocks（每个种群一行，包括物种、渔区、年份、填补的年份、渔获量及其r先验的来源）和excluded（未纳入的种群及原因）。table为TRUE时，这四个表格保存在tables/cmsy/。

English

Invisibly, a list of class cmsy_input with catch and id (the two CMSY++ input tables), stocks (one row per stock with its species, area, years, filled years, catch and the source of its r prior) and excluded (stocks left out, with the reason). When table is TRUE the four tables are saved in tables/cmsy/.

详细说明

FAO统计数据只有渔获量，没有资源丰度指数（CPUE或调查生物量），因此每个种群都只用CMSY++中仅基于渔获量的部分（CMSY：btype = "None"，bt为空）进行评估，不运行贝叶斯Schaefer模型（BSM）。因此，结果主要取决于相对生物量（B/k）的先验；除非在priors中给出，这些先验由CMSY++的人工神经网络设定。结果仅供参考，不能替代资源评估。

一个种群是指一个FAO物种条目在一个渔区内的年渔获量，可以是所有国家的合计（by = "area"，与stock_status()相同），也可以是单个国家的渔获量（by = "country"）。只使用鉴定到种且以吨为单位的条目。按照用户指南的要求，年份必须连续，不允许有缺口：种群从有渔获量的第一年开始，到有渔获量的最后一年结束，其间缺失或为零的渔获量用相邻年份之间的线性插值填补（会报告填补的年数）。以下种群不予纳入：年数少于min_years（CMSY++用最初十年和最后十年设定默认先验）、总渔获量少于min_catch吨、填补年份所占比例超过max_filled，或没有r先验。

每个种群都保留其数据和先验来源的链接：url（该物种的FishBase或SeaLifeBase页面）、data_url（读取先验所用的FishBase或SeaLifeBase数据表）、rule_url（CMSY++用户指南）和fao_data_url（FAO数据的发布版本）。

English

The FAO statistics contain catches only, with no abundance index (CPUE or survey biomass), so every stock is assessed with the catch-only part of CMSY++ (CMSY: btype = "None", bt empty) and the Bayesian Schaefer model (BSM) is not run. The results then depend mostly on the priors for relative biomass (B/k), which CMSY++ sets with its neural network unless they are given in priors; they are indicative and do not replace stock assessments.

A stock is the yearly catch of one FAO species item in one fishing area, summed over all countries (by = "area", as in stock_status()), or of one country (by = "country"). Only items identified to species and measured in tonnes are used. Following the user guide, years must be consecutive and gaps are not allowed: a stock starts with its first and ends with its last year with catch, and missing or zero catches in between are filled by linear interpolation between the adjacent years (the number of filled years is reported). Stocks are left out when they have fewer than min_years years (CMSY++ uses the first and the last ten years for its default priors), less than min_catch tonnes in total, more than max_filled of their years filled, or no prior for r.

Every stock keeps the links to the sources of its data and priors: url (the FishBase or SeaLifeBase page of the species), data_url (the FishBase or SeaLifeBase table the prior was read from), rule_url (the CMSY++ user guide) and fao_data_url (the FAO data release).

参考文献

Froese, R., Demirel, N., Coro, G. and Winker, H. (2021). User Guide for CMSY++. GEOMAR, Germany, 17 pp. https://oceanrep.geomar.de/id/eprint/52147/

Froese, R., Winker, H., Coro, G., et al. (2023). New developments in the analysis of catch time series as the basis for fish stock assessments: the CMSY++ method. Acta Ichthyologica et Piscatoria 53: 173-189. doi:10.3897/aiep.53.105910

示例 

FAO27 <- fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Northeast", plot = FALSE)

# All species of the area that CMSY++ can assess with catch only
input <- cmsy_input(FAO27$area_data, table = FALSE)
input
head(input$stocks[, c("Stock", "species_en", "first_year", "Resilience", "r.low", "r.hi", "r_source")])
table(input$excluded$reason)                      # why the others are left out

# Some species only, by English name, scientific name or FAO 3-alpha code
input <- cmsy_input(FAO27$area_data, species = c("Atlantic herring", "Mallotus villosus", "PRA"),
                    table = FALSE)

# Expert B/k priors (user guide Tables 1 and 3): capelin thought to be depleted in the last year
input <- cmsy_input(FAO27$area_data, species = "CAP", table = FALSE,
                    priors = data.frame(species = "Mallotus villosus", endb.low = 0.2, endb.hi = 0.5))
input$id[, c("Stock", "endb.low", "endb.hi")]

# A start year chosen by the user, and a resilience for species without a FishBase prior
input <- cmsy_input(FAO27$area_data, table = FALSE, default_resilience = "Medium",
                    priors = data.frame(alpha3 = "CAP", StartYear = 1980))

# One stock per country instead of one per area
by_country <- cmsy_input(FAO27$area_data, species = "CAP", by = "country", table = FALSE)
by_country$stocks[, c("Stock", "country", "first_year", "last_year")]
